tagline: Around 70% more floor area than a typical large bed, with three sides to lean on.
lead: Your dog gets three cushioned sides to lean into, like their favourite sofa arm, and an open front to walk straight in.
value: Memory foam, not loose filling, sits inside a waterproof lining, so one accident doesn't reach the foam.
intro: Ash is an XL orthopaedic bolster dog bed, 122 × 89cm, with memory foam and an egg-crate profiled layer inside a waterproof lining, three cushioned sides, an open front and a short-plush cover that unzips to wash.
points: Three bolsters with room for a resting chin or a sideways lean.
No full-height wall on one side, so they can walk straight in.
Around 70% more floor area than a typical 90 × 70cm large bed.
Memory foam with an egg-crate profiled layer, inside a waterproof inner lining.
A short-plush cover that unzips to wash, on a non-skid base that helps it stay put.
best_for: Big dogs who wedge themselves against the sofa arm to switch off, and like an edge without a wall across the front.
fit_note: One size, XL. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. The bolsters take up some of the outside footprint. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
